english.title: Holder of licence to operate PHV fail to produce licence on request from authorised person of council / constable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been granted a licence by **(..SPECIFY COUNCIL..) under section 55 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 to operate private hire vehicles, without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with a request from

(A)_[an authorised officer, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED OFFICER..) of **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..),]_
(B)_[a constable, namely **(..SPECIFY CONSTABLE..),]_

to produce your licence
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 56(4) and (5) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
